why_this_stage_exists.measured_problem: the J4 recovery corpus is 12 aligned rows against July's 356. A second progressive iteration adds nothing: the J5-r2 trace truncates at exactly the same step 13, on the same column online_left_in_contact.
why_this_stage_exists.measured_cause: the alignment reference was wrong. J4 compared the J1 TEACHER trace with a STUDENT trace, so the very first contact-onset difference (teacher step 14, student step 13) truncated everything. July compared a STUDENT nominal trace with STUDENT perturbed traces.
why_this_stage_exists.july_evidence: markov_dataset_report.json of target_domain_markov35_phase_aligned_scaled_full_r32_alt8_2026-07-13 records nominal_trace = .../2026-07-13_markov35_zero_column_deterministic/rollout_policy_trace.json, a deterministic STUDENT rollout, and three recovery traces from stochastic sigma-0.005 student rollouts (seeds 123, 124, ...).
why_this_stage_exists.measured_confirmation: J3 student vs J5-r2 student retains 500/500 rows with no discrete mismatch at all, while J1 teacher vs either student retains 12.

scope.what_this_stage_does: collects THREE stochastic recovery traces from the pinned J2 actor and audits, offline, the aligned prefix of each against the J3 deterministic base-student trace
what_this_stage_does_not_do: it does not build the Markov recovery dataset
it does not fit, adapt or train anything
it does not touch the critic and runs no PPO
it does not promote anything and authorises no next stage
it does not modify J0-J5, their receipts, traces or modules, the penetration contract, or production

operational_parent.statement: the J2 base student is the ONLY operational parent. It is the same single 35D student derived from the August V26 imitation parent.
operational_parent.j4_and_j5_are_evidence_only: the J4 recovery module and the J5 rollouts are EVIDENCE. They are never a parent, never weights, never labels and never a dataset for this stage.
operational_parent.why: the probe rolls out the BASE student exactly as J3 did, so its controller-memory columns are still masked. Lifting them is the business of a later recovery fit, not of this collection.
operational_parent.not_the_j4_module: the J4 recovery module state is 14a3630f757a5da2055eb754f6249fad8e7989a6d5e6c18f526c76415dad31aa and is explicitly NOT used here. This stage rolls out the J2 base module 0f182ea9f8939e2b7824e85c12c57343309c444680682b9bce5858dd74f9d130.

sigma.status: HYPOTHESIS UNDER TEST, NOT A SELECTED VALUE
sigma.note: 0.005 is July's exploration sigma. Whether it is the right magnitude here is exactly what this probe measures; nothing in this amendment selects it.

no_module_copy_required.finding: the pinned J2 module ALREADY carries sigma = 0.005 in its frozen log-std head: pi.1.weight[2:] is exactly zero and pi.1.bias[2:] = -5.2983174324035645, so exp(bias) = 0.005 to within 3.3e-10.
no_module_copy_required.consequence: no derived module, no edited log-std head, no copy. The parent is used bit-for-bit as it is, which makes the 'mean actor bit-exact / non-logstd tensors bit-exact / save-reload exact' obligations trivially satisfied and verifiable by identity.
no_module_copy_required.if_this_ever_fails: the stage refuses to run rather than editing the head.

noise.application: the action is the policy mean plus sigma times the held standard normal, exactly the stochastic_held semantics of rollout_eval

nominal_trace_for_alignment_and_self_anc.why: it is the deterministic base-student rollout, the exact analogue of July's markov35_zero_column_deterministic nominal trace. The J1 teacher trace is NOT the alignment reference.

truncation_rule.rule: each recovery trace is truncated at its FIRST discrete mismatch against the J3 nominal trace
truncation_rule.no_minimum_length_gate: there is NO numeric gate on prefix length. July's retained prefixes of 119, 118 and 119 are DESCRIPTIVE reference only and are never a threshold.

runtime.start: nominal, the same episode start offset as J1/J3/J5

penetration.semantics: exactly the contract helper: above soft iff > 0.020, July legacy breach iff >= 0.025, binding pass iff <= 0.028 and FAIL iff > 0.028

outcome_policy.this_stage_produces: three recovery traces plus an offline prefix audit
outcome_policy.on_failure: artefacts preserved and quarantined; no autonomous retry

immutability: this file is content-addressed by the artefacts it pins. Any change to a pinned artefact invalidates it. It is never edited in place.

supersedes.status: PRESERVED AS A FORENSIC DRAFT. rev1 declared itself immutable, so it is neither edited nor deleted; it is superseded by this rev2, which is the operative one.
what_changed: the ACTION path is now the production one: rollout_eval._held_stochastic_action, which uses forward_exploration and the policy's EFFECTIVE std. rev1 described mean + sigma * noise computed locally.

the VERDICT is now the full episode gate, not penetration alone. steps, end_reason, valid cycles, both phase timeouts, morphology causal failure, hs cancellations and resync are each binding, with penetration binding only at > 0.028.
the local truncation transcription is now proven at RUNTIME against target_domain_noise_adaptation.truncate_before_discrete_mismatch; the preflight keeps the wrapper so it stays inert.

action_semantics.std: the policy's EFFECTIVE std, as returned by the helper - never a locally assumed sigma
action_semantics.noise: held standard normal, hold = 1, seeded per run
action_semantics.identity_checked: applied_noise == std * unit_noise, verified every step
action_semantics.inference_exploration_parity: the exploration mean and std must equal the forward_inference mean and std at EVERY step. If the two paths ever diverged, the probe would be exploring around a different policy than the one J3 rolled out, and the run aborts.
action_semantics.declared_sigma_status: HYPOTHESIS UNDER TEST - it is checked against the policy's effective std, not imposed on it

binding_gate.statement: a collection is usable only if the EPISODE is intact. Staying shallow is not enough.
binding_gate.source: v26c_j1_collect.J1_GATE for every non-penetration criterion; the penetration criterion is the penetration contract's sole hard binding band

penetration_bands.note: > 0.020 and >= 0.025 are DIAGNOSTIC and never fail this gate; only > 0.028 does

binding_gate.cli: the CLI exits non-zero on ANY binding failure, not only on penetration

truncation_parity.rule: the local transcription is compared with the July production function at runtime
truncation_parity.why_a_wrapper_remains: importing the July module pulls target_domain_imitation -> env_factory -> win_runtime -> torch, which would break the inert preflight. The wrapper keeps the preflight inert; the heavy path proves the parity.
